question: Does locked Google Research TabFM provide material OOF quality gain over the accepted GBDT_mean baseline on the same 47 permitted KOMUS features?
compute_assessment: Observed CPU inference throughput makes full OOF multi-day and potentially multi-week. Exact full-OOF runtime is not established because part of wall elapsed was contaminated by machine sleep/idle.
facts: Runtime/dataset guards, exact checkpoint SHA, locked model load, real inference preflight, and single-call versus chunked equivalence passed. Full 3-fold OOF was not started.
interpretation: The locked TabFM path is technically reproducible, but the quality comparison with GBDT_mean remains unresolved.
limitations: SAFE-RUN is not a quality proxy. It establishes neither TabFM OOF metrics nor a conclusion that TabFM is worse or better than GBDT_mean.
decision: STOPPED_BY_COMPUTE_COST; keep RUN_FULL_OOF=false and do not run full OOF on the current CPU environment.
provenance: Retrospective summary created from the preserved accepted notebook and operational evidence without a repeated ML run.
